About smile.up

Care That Goes Beyond Your Smile

smile.up Dental Hospital & Implant Centre is a neighbourhood dental hospital in Gowliguda, Hyderabad, located in Sanghi Arcade, opposite the Central Gurudwara. Our focus is simple: good dental health, delivered with patience and respect.

Every visit starts with listening. We take time to understand your concern, explain what we find in plain language, and talk through your options before any treatment begins, so you always know what to expect.

Patient-Centred ApproachYour comfort and questions come first.
Professional Dental CareCareful, hygienic clinical practice.
Comfortable Clinical EnvironmentA clean, calm space to be treated in.
Personalized TreatmentPlans shaped around your needs.
